$description: Made by themetron. In each theme, grades with the same number have the same luminance in every palette.

key.$description: The key color, exactly as given.
The key color, exactly as given.

roundness.$description: The roundness, from 0 to 1. A part with height h rounds by roundness × h ÷ 2, a pill at 1.

fillAlphaInverted.$description: The fill opacity of a part with tm-invert.

tintAlpha.$description: The tint opacity of soft and quiet buttons.

tintAlphaInverted.$description: The tint opacity of a part with tm-invert.

edgeAlpha.$description: The opacity of button and card edges: 1, fading to 0.5 over the top tenth of softness.

fillAlphaClearest.$description: The opacity of a solid fill at clarity 1.

tintAlphaInvertedClearest.$description: The opacity of an inverted tint at clarity 1.

moreContrast.$description: For readers who ask for more contrast: CSS prefers-contrast: more, or data-tm-contrast="more".
